content: Ene always made the kitchen feel like the heart of the home. Even when life was busy, she somehow made everyone gather around the table and talk for hours.
Jaanika was always the one who looked after everyone without making a fuss about it. She had a way of bringing calm to every family gathering.
Liis had the kind of laughter that filled the room instantly. Even simple family evenings felt brighter when she was there.
Marju has always been deeply thoughtful and full of kindness. I still remember how patiently she listened to everyone before speaking.
